```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(knitr)
  library(googlesheets4)
})

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Paths + helpers from ensemble_lib.R (sourced below). Override via
# `NFL_PROJECT_DIR=/some/path` to relocate the repo.

# Constants
SHEETS_URL     <- 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1bBT9MqBJO8FUqHRNk33IfHDlvAMWZS-NBgruz5EKhe8/edit?usp=sharing'

# TARGET_SEASON + TARGET_WEEK explicitly pick what to predict.
# Set TARGET_WEEK = NULL to auto-detect "current" week (first incomplete week).
# Both must be present in data/game_w_features.csv — rebuild features if missing.
TARGET_SEASON  <- 2026
TARGET_WEEK    <- 1     # NULL for auto

# Portfolio config — set BANKROLL to your current bankroll. Betting params + EV
# calibration come from the canonical engine, set below once ensemble_lib + the
# bundle are loaded (PARAMS = PORTFOLIO_DEFAULTS, EV cal baked into the bundle).
BANKROLL       <- 10000   # dollars

source("~/Projects/R/nfl_predictor/ensemble_lib.R")
BUNDLE_PATH     <- file.path(MODELS_DIR, "ensemble_latest.rds")
game_w_features <- read.csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "game_w_features.csv"))
bundle          <- readRDS(BUNDLE_PATH)

# Canonical betting engine: PORTFOLIO_DEFAULTS (min_ev = 0.05 on CALIBRATED EV)
# + the bundle's baked EV calibration — identical to export_upcoming/grade_week.
PARAMS <- PORTFOLIO_DEFAULTS
EV_CAL <- ev_calibration_from_bundle(bundle)

cat(sprintf("Bundle: trained %s on %d games (seasons %d-%d) | σ=%.2f\n",
            bundle$metadata$trained_date,
            bundle$metadata$n_training_games,
            bundle$metadata$training_seasons[1],
            bundle$metadata$training_seasons[2],
            bundle$sigma))
cat(sprintf("Portfolio: bankroll $%s | min_ev=%.2f | kelly_mult=%.2f\n",
            format(BANKROLL, big.mark = ","), PARAMS$min_ev, PARAMS$kelly_mult))

# Verify target season/week exists in features
available_seasons <- sort(unique(game_w_features$season))
if (!TARGET_SEASON %in% available_seasons) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "TARGET_SEASON=%d not in game_w_features.csv (have %d-%d). Run build_features.R.",
    TARGET_SEASON, min(available_seasons), max(available_seasons)))
}
target_games_check <- game_w_features %>%
  filter(season == TARGET_SEASON,
         if (!is.null(TARGET_WEEK)) week == TARGET_WEEK else TRUE)
if (nrow(target_games_check) == 0) {
  stop(sprintf("No games found for season=%d week=%s — rebuild features.",
               TARGET_SEASON, if (is.null(TARGET_WEEK)) "(any)" else TARGET_WEEK))
}
cat(sprintf("Target: season %d, week %s (%d games available)\n",
            TARGET_SEASON,
            if (is.null(TARGET_WEEK)) "<auto>" else as.character(TARGET_WEEK),
            nrow(target_games_check)))
```

```{r helpers}
# Resolve TARGET_WEEK: if NULL, pick the earliest week with any incomplete games
resolve_target_week <- function(data, season, target_week) {
  if (!is.null(target_week)) return(target_week)
  cand <- data %>%
    filter(season == !!season) %>%
    transmute(week, gameday = as.Date(gameday)) %>%
    group_by(week) %>%
    summarise(last_gameday = max(gameday), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    filter(Sys.Date() <= last_gameday) %>%
    arrange(week) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(week)
  if (length(cand) == 0) stop(sprintf(
    "No incomplete week found in season %d — all games look completed. Set TARGET_WEEK explicitly.",
    season))
  cand
}

# Add cover/ml correctness back in (needed for historical YTD scoring)
score_predictions <- function(preds, raw_games) {
  preds %>%
    left_join(
      raw_games %>% select(game_id, home_result, home_win,
                           home_spread_odds, away_spread_odds),
      by = "game_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      spread_winner       = if_else(home_result - spread_line > 0, home_team, away_team),
      pred_spread_winner  = if_else(line_diff > 0, home_team, away_team),
      pred_winner         = if_else(nfl_predictor_line > 0, home_team, away_team),
      winning_team        = if_else(home_win == 1, home_team, away_team),
      spread_push         = !is.na(home_result) & !is.na(spread_line) &
                             (home_result - spread_line == 0),
      ml_tie              = !is.na(home_result) & (home_result == 0),
      cover_correct       = if_else(spread_push, NA_integer_,
                                     as.integer(pred_spread_winner == spread_winner)),
      ml_correct          = if_else(ml_tie, NA_integer_,
                                     as.integer(pred_winner == winning_team))
    )
}
```

# Bet card

```{r current-week}
target_week <- resolve_target_week(game_w_features, TARGET_SEASON, TARGET_WEEK)

cur_wk_games <- game_w_features %>%
  filter(week == target_week, season == TARGET_SEASON)

cat(sprintf("Predictions for Week %d, %d (%d games)\n\n",
            target_week, TARGET_SEASON, nrow(cur_wk_games)))

cur_wk_preds <- predict_with_ensemble(bundle, cur_wk_games) %>%
  left_join(cur_wk_games %>% select(game_id, home_spread_odds, away_spread_odds),
            by = "game_id")

bet_card <- generate_bet_card(cur_wk_preds, BANKROLL, PARAMS, bundle = bundle)

if (nrow(bet_card) == 0) {
  cat("No bets pass the EV threshold this week.\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("Bet card: %d bets totaling $%s of stake\n\n",
              nrow(bet_card), format(round(sum(bet_card$stake)), big.mark = ",")))
  bet_card %>%
    transmute(
      game     = sprintf("%s @ %s", away_team, home_team),
      bet      = sprintf("%s %s", bet_team, str_remove(bet_type, "^(home|away)_")),
      odds     = sprintf("%+d", round(odds)),
      ev       = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * ev),
      kelly    = sprintf("%.3f", kelly_frac),
      stake    = sprintf("$%s", format(stake, big.mark = ",")),
      win_pays = sprintf("+$%s", format(round(payout_if_win), big.mark = ","))
    ) %>% print()

  cat(sprintf("\nTotal expected value this week: $%s\n",
              format(round(sum(bet_card$expected_value)), big.mark = ",")))
}

# Push to Google Sheet
if (interactive()) {
  sheet_name <- glue::glue("bet_card_{TARGET_SEASON}_wk{target_week}_{Sys.Date()}")
  sheet_write(bet_card, ss = SHEETS_URL, sheet = sheet_name)
}
```

# YTD portfolio performance

Replay the bet card retroactively for each completed week of the target season
prior to TARGET_WEEK, then walk the bankroll forward.

```{r ytd-portfolio}
ytd_completed <- game_w_features %>%
  filter(season == TARGET_SEASON, week < target_week, !is.na(home_result))

if (nrow(ytd_completed) == 0) {
  cat("No completed games yet this season.\n")
} else {
  ytd_preds <- predict_with_ensemble(bundle, ytd_completed) %>%
    left_join(ytd_completed %>% select(game_id, home_spread_odds, away_spread_odds),
              by = "game_id") %>%
    score_predictions(ytd_completed)

  cands_with_outcomes <- build_bet_candidates(ytd_preds)

  # Walk bankroll forward week by week
  bankroll <- BANKROLL
  ytd_bets <- list()
  for (wk in sort(unique(cands_with_outcomes$week))) {
    wk_cands <- cands_with_outcomes %>% filter(week == wk)
    wk_bets  <- filter_and_size_bets(wk_cands, bankroll, PARAMS, EV_CAL)
    if (nrow(wk_bets) > 0) {
      wk_bets <- wk_bets %>%
        mutate(
          pnl = case_when(
            is.na(correct)   ~ 0,
            correct == 1     ~ pnl_for_win(stake, odds),
            TRUE             ~ -stake
          )
        )
      bankroll <- bankroll + sum(wk_bets$pnl)
      wk_bets$bankroll_after <- bankroll
      ytd_bets[[length(ytd_bets) + 1]] <- wk_bets
    }
  }
  ytd_bets <- bind_rows(ytd_bets)

  if (nrow(ytd_bets) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("No bets cleared the %.0f%% EV threshold YTD.\n", 100 * PARAMS$min_ev))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("YTD: %d bets, %d wins, %d pushes, %d losses\n",
                nrow(ytd_bets),
                sum(ytd_bets$correct == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                sum(is.na(ytd_bets$correct)),
                sum(ytd_bets$correct == 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
    cat(sprintf("Total staked: $%s | Total PnL: $%s | ROI: %.2f%%\n",
                format(round(sum(ytd_bets$stake)),  big.mark = ","),
                format(round(sum(ytd_bets$pnl)),    big.mark = ","),
                100 * sum(ytd_bets$pnl) / sum(ytd_bets$stake)))
    cat(sprintf("Bankroll: $%s → $%s (%.1f%%)\n",
                format(BANKROLL, big.mark = ","),
                format(round(bankroll), big.mark = ","),
                100 * (bankroll - BANKROLL) / BANKROLL))

    # By bet type
    cat("\nBy bet type:\n")
    ytd_bets %>%
      group_by(bet_type) %>%
      summarise(
        n       = n(),
        wins    = sum(correct == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        win_pct = round(mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
        stake   = round(sum(stake), 0),
        pnl     = round(sum(pnl), 0),
        roi     = round(sum(pnl) / sum(stake), 3),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>% print()

    # By week
    cat("\nBy week:\n")
    ytd_bets %>%
      group_by(week) %>%
      summarise(
        n_bets   = n(),
        stake    = round(sum(stake), 0),
        pnl      = round(sum(pnl), 0),
        bankroll = round(last(bankroll_after), 0),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>% print()
  }
}
```
